budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Two teams capture the enemy physical beacon and carry it onto their own base while their own beacon is on its home tile and uncarried.
task.natural_termination: The first transition with any valid capture ends the joint episode; otherwise horizon 96 truncates. A natural capture on step 96 takes priority.
task.interaction: Bodies block movement; axial tags stun opponents and drop their cargo; same-team pass plus receive transfers a beacon; signals share live radar but reveal the transmitter; decoys jam hostile radar near them and absorb a closest tag beam.
task.observation_access: Public layout, bases, clock, score and announcer event ids. Scouts have Manhattan radar radius 4 and couriers 2, across walls. Hostile decoys hide agents and beacons within one tile of the decoy from observers more than one tile away. Active decoys themselves remain radar-visible. A signalling teammate shares its current masked radar; each signaller body is public. Scene masks equal these observation accesses; hidden attributes are zero.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Number of actual beacon captures by team
Public announcer: roles hit by a tag this step
Public announcer: roles deploying a reflector this step
Public announcer: roles initiating a signal this step
Public announcer: beacon ids picked up this step
Public announcer: beacon ids passed between teammates this step
Public announcer: beacon ids returned to their home this step
Public announcer: teams capturing an enemy beacon this step

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
